summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony: analyze confidential supplier/ERP data, build a general recheck-and-act agent product (Lighthouse), prep interviews, and polish the UI before the Sunday 12:00 hand-in.
summary.outcome: Found that Soony's launch plan hid real Collector's Edition shortfalls (overbooked art books, failed statues, etc.), built a polling/versioned-store/agent pipeline and web app with Maren/Felix views, and shipped a 'How we got here' case flow plus multiple UI fixes on main. At session end main was about 14 commits ahead of origin, unpushed, with the top-bar layout fix still being verified.

repo: Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/ (raw, drops, notes, img); .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN and is gitignored while .env.example is committed.
The portal API has only list files, get file and archive.zip, with no webhooks; changes are detected by polling and comparing per-file SHA-256, and files can be replaced under the same name.
Team workflow is in CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md; claim tasks in PROGRESS.md and pull teammates' changes before building.
Routines call Claude (claude-opus-5-5) with the key from .env independent of ASK_LLM_PROVIDER, so they work on the demo.
The API does not load .env on import, so settings like ASK_VIEWER_TITLE must be read via a helper that loads .env first, otherwise they are missing after restart.

Routine steps are valid only for certain watched kinds: 'chase once if no answer' needs messages awaiting a reply, 'ask for a status' needs shipments; the server rejects others with 'step N cannot be done on open decisions'.
Case flow reuses the connector and node box exported from FlowGraph.tsx so the routine diagram and the case flow cannot drift apart.
Live runs on :8000 and the demo at ask-soony-demo.stenglein.dev; rebuilding the web app updates both, but new server endpoints need a restart.

Lucas's new-approach branch carries a second escalation loop and a pulse-console app that would duplicate main's escalation loop, card_alerts phone bridge, and bypass the duplicate-send guard and record-only mode.

code.finding: Pulse-style two-column snake layout read right-to-left on the second row and was confusing; replaced by a single top-to-bottom column built from case data (portal, reader, verifier, prediction, approval rule, decision, then), omitting steps the data lacks.
Exports the Link connector and node box so other components can share the routine diagram's look.

workflow: Subagents are effective for bulk cross-checking (200 order confirmations and 59 scans against SAP) and for generating design variants without touching the repo.
Preview UI changes on a copy of the demo state with background off and email record-only, taking desktop and phone screenshots before merging.
Build speculative work on separate branches/worktrees; the user rejected the merged Pulse-style chat as the wrong interpretation, and the merge was reverted cleanly because it was unpushed.
Confirm what the team actually liked (the flow view) from screenshots and interview notes before building.
Entire hooks skip checkpoints when no repo files change; its log in .entire shows turn start/end events, and it uploads checkpoints on git push.
Keep confidential data and supplier details out of code and external services; user-facing docs/artifacts are private until shared.

friction: The first Pulse-chat build misread the user's intent and had to be merged then reverted, wasting time.
The two-column case flow was confusing and needed redesign, then restyling to match the routine diagram.
Adding 'chase once' failed because the Add-step menu offered steps invalid for the routine's watch kind.
The top bar became crowded after adding the role chip and status text; the heartbeat was absolutely positioned and overlapped the status.
The API not loading .env caused a setting to be missing after restart.
Rendered pages could not always be checked in a real browser, so several changes were verified only by screenshots or builds.
Time pressure in the last ~15 minutes before the 12:00 hand-in, with main unpushed.
open_items: Push main (about 14 commits ahead of origin) and restart live so sign-in choice, Maren's 'Waiting for your OK' and heartbeat appear there.
Finish verifying the top-bar 3-column grid at 1100, 1440 and 390 px widths and commit it.
Port 'read new documents before verifying' from Lucas's new-approach branch (about 20 min) after the hand-in, keeping the no-model skip and try/except safeguards.
Pick a Lighthouse logo variant (assistant favors 3, subagent favors 2) and apply it to favicon, top bar and sign-in.
Declutter the Routines page: compact list rows, one open at a time, ⋯ menu, duplicate-routine detection.
Support 'send email, then chase once if no answer' on decision routines via a reply-watching follow-up.
Optionally make 'N decisions' open the case list as a phone bottom sheet.
Pitch deck and video still open; the old Claude doc may be deleted.
Register sender addresses in the portal and send the Karton Nowak order (24 h offer) plus a Boise reply on terms via the product.
Unconfirmed whether portal data and supplier-reply effects differ between teams; ask the Lio engineers.
jonas/pulse-ui chat branch remains parked off main; browser interaction with the 'Describe it' chat was never tested.
